cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Drop the Armor
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to lower their guard, stop performing strength, or admit what affects them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. You've locked the shop. You can stop doing the cheerful voice for me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Someone has to keep morale up. You're my only employee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I'm off the clock. What did that empty till do to you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I cried in the stockroom. Then I practised smiling.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You don't owe me a second performance. Can we lock the stockroom and let you be upset out here?
